name: Touhou OST Music Pack
description_html:
WARNING: DUE TO GOOGLE DRIVE DELETING FILES WHEN UNZIPPED DOWNLOAD BOBBY’s MUSIC PLAYER FIRST AND THEN THIS MOD. MOVE ONLY THE AUDIO FILES NOT THE DLL. ALT SOLUTION: Download the ZIP files from my link in Bobby’s Mod Page and then unzip them to a folder or desktop

This mod adds in the OST of all Touhou games from 1-19. This mod is heavy as it’s 5 GB. so be aware of that when you download this. (for reference, the jazz Touhou one is 3GB) all credit goes to ZUN for his games and Music he is the og producer for this. (this does not violate ZUN’s copyright rules)

Install Instructions: Drag BepinEx Folder into SPT directory

This mod is also on Oddba for any users there. (if your able to access it)

Updated to 3.10.X version of SPT.

Preview: https://youtu.be/HZvnP0svJzk?si=S78TMKj96ne6bMwN
